titulo: Niches with a barrier: opportunities 30 to 36
lead: All seven in this group are building: dormant-base reactivation, finance, events, health, public tenders, visualization, and data extraction. What they have in common is the barrier, and the barrier is trust: a contact who gave permission, a notice said in big letters, a decision that is not yours, and a guarantee only with a measured baseline.
objetivo: check contact authorization, notices, limits, and baseline before proposing anything in a niche with a barrier.

aprende.t: The trust piece each one requires
Sell research and tools, never the decision
Measure the baseline before you promise

hero_alt: Professional reviews a printed consent form and a checklist with the owner of a clinic, at the reception counter.

secoes.sub: All of them are building. Three of them carry a paper trust piece. Click each box.

nos.detalhe: Each one is a deliverable built for a niche. Finance and health still require real grounding in the field: "only enter if you're from the field" and "the warnings are not a detail."
Before proposing reactivation, confirm that those contacts agreed to receive messages. Checking data and permission is Auditor work, and it applies to any customer base.

Guarantee only with a baseline: how many closings per week before, at the same time of year, and four weeks with the tool with nothing else changing. Measuring the before and after is Consultant work.
In bids, smaller firms often prefer to install once and train the team. It's the most comfortable option for both sides.
None of the seven is ongoing support for a manager who builds.

secoes.legenda: A barrier is not a reason to run from the niche. It's what separates the people who have confidence from the people who only have a tool.

secoes.sub: One question for each, before any proposal.

texto: Did the old contacts agree to receive messages? Without that there is no proposal.
And before you quote a percentage, understand their math: gross margin is not net margin, and there is a cost to serve each sale.
Sell tools and research, never investment recommendations. Whoever sells research so others can decide has a business; whoever sells the decision has exposure.
This is not legal or financial advice: it's the line between product and risk.
If you are not a health professional, that has to be stated everywhere, in large type: each person follows up with their own doctor, and nothing there is clinical guidance.
Measure how many closings per week there were before, track four weeks without changing anything else, and state the whole comparison.
Promise an absolute number, not a percentage: a percentage is easy to argue about later.

secoes.sub: Fill this in before you propose in a niche with a barrier.

blocos.conteudo:
CHECKLIST DE BARREIRA · <empresa> · <data>

[ ] DADOS: os contatos/dados que vou usar foram autorizados para esse uso? Quem confirmou, por escrito?
[ ] LIMITE: estou vendendo ferramenta/pesquisa ou estou decidindo pelo cliente? (decidir = fora)
[ ] AVISOS: preciso de aviso de que não sou profissional da área? Onde ele aparece?
[ ] MATEMÁTICA: sei a margem líquida e o custo de atender cada venda antes de dizer um número?
[ ] LINHA DE BASE: qual é o número de antes, em que período, e o que não pode mudar durante a medição?
[ ] ESPECIALISTA: em que ponto eu chamo alguém habilitado (jurídico, saúde, finanças)?

Se algum item ficou sem resposta, a proposta espera.

exercicios.texto: Pick a business you know that has a contact list that has been idle for more than six months (store, clinic, school). Fill in the checklist with what you know and mark what you need to ask.
exercicios.pronto: all 6 items have an answer or the exact question you will ask, and the DADOS item says who confirms the permission.

exercicios.texto: For that business, write which number you would measure before any promise, and enter 30 through 36 in the filter table.
exercicios.pronto: you have the metric, the "before" period, the length of the tracking, and what cannot change midway; the 7 rows are in the table.

perguntas.p: You are going to propose commission-based list reactivation. What do you need to know before you quote the percentage?
opcoes: Whether the contacts agreed to it, and their cost structure: gross margin, net margin, and the cost to serve each sale
perguntas.explica: Without permission there is no proposal. And a commission that ignores net margin can leave them with nothing, and the contract dies early.

perguntas.p: In the financial market, what can you safely sell?
opcoes: Tools and research so others can decide better
perguntas.explica: Whoever sells the decision carries the exposure. Tools and research stay on the product side, and only if this is your field.

perguntas.p: When can you offer a results guarantee on a visualization tool?
opcoes: After measuring the baseline and tracking for four weeks without changing anything else
perguntas.explica: With the before measured and the comparison fully stated, the guarantee is safe. Without a baseline, it's a bet.

itens.texto: All of them deliver something built for a niche.
Auditor on authorization, Consultant on measurement, Trainer on the team.
Legal, health and finance stay with those who are licensed.
